_comment: House netclasses for milled boards. Paste into a project's .kicad_pro
under net_settings, or set them in Board Setup > Net Classes.
Vias are 0.9mm with a 0.6mm hole to match house-mill.kicad_dru. Nothing is
plated at home, so every via is a rivet or a soldered wire and has to be
big enough to work by hand. KiCad's stock default of 0.6/0.3 fails the DRU.
Track widths are set by what fits between pads, not by current. A 2.54mm
DIP pad grid leaves a 0.94mm gap, so 0.2mm clearance either side allows
0.54mm maximum. PWR at 0.45mm passes with margin. Signal current on these
modules is milliamps, so 0.25mm is already many times what is needed.
